caveats: Contiguity is built over the 2265 counties that received at least one response, not all ~3,143 US counties; non-responding counties are absent, so some neighbours are nearest-responding rather than border-sharing.
Team variables are EB-adjusted shares (team count / county total responses), not raw counts.
'total' is survey response density, which largely tracks population; no per-capita normalisation is available.
